feature.name: User Authentication System
feature.description: Multi-factor authentication with email/password, OAuth providers, and account security features
requirements: Users can register with email and password
Password must meet complexity requirements (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char)
Users can log in with email/password
Account locks after 5 failed login attempts within 15 minutes
Locked accounts automatically unlock after 1 hour
Users can request password reset via email
Password reset link valid for 1 hour

    user = create_user('test@example.com', 'Password123!')
    assert user is not None
    assert user.email == 'test@example.com'

def test_login():
    user = User.objects.get(email='test@example.com')
    result = login(user.email, 'Password123!')
    assert result == True
